expected_findings.summary: `Number(req.query.page) || 1` only rewrites 0/NaN; negative, fractional and Infinity values reach listings.page, which computes OFFSET = (page - 1) * size, producing a negative OFFSET (database error / 500) for negative values and a wrong page or non-integer OFFSET for fractional ones. Validate with Number.isInteger(page) && page >= 1 (and cap it), otherwise fall back to 1.
